env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd dropped
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:10:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
! stderr 'unsupervised_goroutine'
! exists dropped
! exists dropped$GOEXE
cd ..

cd dropped
logos build ./...
! stderr .
go build ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

cd allowed
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

cd warned
logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:6:2: warning: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
cd ..

cd recursive
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:3:6: \[correctness::infinite_recursion\]'
! stderr 'allow_forbidden_rule'
cd ..

cd recursive_allowed
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

cd recursive_lgo
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:3:1: \[correctness::allow_forbidden_rule\]'
cd ..

cd dropped
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
cd ..

cd recursive
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
cd ..

cd goforbid
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

cd app
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
logos lint example.com/dep
! stderr .
logos build ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

cd lgoapp
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
logos lint example.com/lgodep
! stderr .
logos build ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

cd lgodep
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'dep\.lgo:6:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
cd ..

cd ws/a
! logos lint example.com/wsb
stderr 'b\.go:6:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
cd ../..

-- dropped/go.mod --
module example.com/dropped

go 1.27

-- dropped/main.go --
package main

import (
	"os"

	"example.com/dropped/lib"
)

func run() {
	os.Remove("missing")
	go work()
}

func work() {}

func main() {
	run()
	println(lib.Name())
}

-- dropped/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }

-- allowed/go.mod --
module example.com/allowed

go 1.27

-- allowed/main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	//logos:allow(slop::discarded_error)
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- allowed/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }

-- warned/go.mod --
module example.com/warned

go 1.27

-- warned/logos.toml --
[lints]
slop = "warn"

-- warned/main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- warned/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }

-- recursive/go.mod --
module example.com/recursive

go 1.27

-- recursive/main.go --
package main

func loop(n int) int {
	return loop(n)
}

func main() {
	println(loop(1))
}

-- recursive/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }

-- recursive_allowed/go.mod --
module example.com/recursive_allowed

go 1.27

-- recursive_allowed/main.go --
package main

//logos:allow(correctness::infinite_recursion)
func loop(n int) int {
	return loop(n)
}

func main() {
	println(loop(1))
}

-- recursive_allowed/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }

-- recursive_lgo/go.mod --
module example.com/recursive_lgo

go 1.27

-- recursive_lgo/main.lgo --
package main

//logos:allow(correctness::infinite_recursion)
func loop(n int) int {
	return loop(n)
}

func main() {
	println(loop(1))
}

func Name() string { return "lib" }

-- app/go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.27

require example.com/dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/dep => ../dep

-- app/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/dep"

func main() {
	println(dep.Name())
}

-- app/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }

-- ws/go.work --

	./a
	./b
)

package a

func A() {}

-- ws/b/go.mod --
module example.com/wsb

-- ws/b/b.go --

import "os"

func B() {
	os.Remove("missing")
}
